price_policy: Starting prices marked From; vehicle size and condition may affect the final quote.

services.name: Essential Clean
services.summary: A regular inside-and-out clean to keep your car looking fresh.
includes: Hand wash of the exterior, including wheels and tyres
Interior vacuum
Gloss-enhancing spray sealant for short-term paint protection

services.name: Full Valet
services.duration: Approx. 3–4 hours; varies with vehicle size
services.summary: A deeper clean for the bodywork, wheels and interior.
includes: Seat, carpet and mat shampooing, followed by wet-vac extraction
Steam cleaning of interior plastics and tight areas
Exterior detailing and gloss-enhancing sealant

services.name: Interior Deep Clean
services.summary: A thorough clean for an interior that is dirty, stained or in need of a reset.
includes: Shampooing of seats, carpets and mats
Wet-vac extraction and steam cleaning
Cleaning of dashboard, door cards and boot

services.name: Maintenance Plans
services.summary: Regular return visits to keep your car clean after its first Full Valet.
includes: Initial Full Valet to establish a clean baseline
Subsequent upkeep based on an Essential Clean
Fragrance and finishing details discussed for the vehicle
booking_notes: Frequency, price and visit duration are not specified on the published website.

services.name: Paint Decontamination
services.summary: Removes stubborn contamination that an ordinary wash can leave behind.
includes: Treatment for tar, road grime, bird lime, mould and iron particles where suitable
Clay-bar treatment for contamination still stuck to the paint
booking_notes: Also included as preparation where required in Paint Enhancement, Paint Correction and Ceramic Coating.

services.name: Paint Enhancement
services.summary: A single-stage machine polish to reduce light marks and bring back gloss.
includes: Deep clean to remove stubborn contamination
Machine polishing focused on light surface marks
Up to three months of paint protection

services.name: Paint Correction
services.duration: Approx. 5 hours / most of a day
services.summary: More intensive machine polishing for noticeable swirls and marks, where the paint allows.
includes: Deep clean to remove stubborn contamination
Deeper polishing, followed by a finishing stage where required
Up to three months of paint protection
booking_notes: The current site describes a goal of approximately 95% of defects that can safely be corrected; this is conditional on paint condition, not a guaranteed removal percentage.

services.name: 3-year Ceramic Coating
services.summary: A three-year liquid coating that adds gloss and makes regular washing easier.
includes: Deep exterior clean to remove stubborn contamination
Single-stage machine polish to improve light marks and gloss
Final surface clean so the coating can bond correctly
Coating on exterior glass and wheel faces
Water-repellent protection for easier maintenance
booking_notes: Suitable dry weather and curing conditions are required.
Final price depends on vehicle size and condition.

services.name: Headlight Restoration
services.summary: Improves cloudy or yellowed headlight lenses so they look clearer.
includes: Careful wet sanding to remove the damaged surface layer
Two-stage machine polishing
Three-year ceramic coating protection

services.name: Caravan & Motorhome
services.summary: Tell us about your caravan or motorhome and the areas you would like cleaned.
booking_notes: Scope, price and duration are agreed by enquiry.

services.name: PPF (Paint Protection Film)
services.summary: Ask about clear protective film for the parts of your vehicle most at risk from stone chips.
booking_notes: Website advertises enquiries only; it does not publish an installation package, price or duration.
